summary: System that checks paper tests (from photos or typed answers), grades them, gives per-question feedback, and recommends reading materials using embeddings and a vector DB.

stories.title: User registration & login (basic)
stories.description: Allow Admin, Teacher, and Student accounts to register and log in. Use JWT for API auth.
acceptance_criteria: Given an unauthenticated user, when they POST valid credentials to /api/auth/login, then return a JWT and user role.
Given a new user request to /api/auth/register with unique email, when valid data is provided, then create user and return 201.
Given invalid credentials, when login attempted, then return 401 with an error message.
data_models: User {id, name, email, role, passwordHash, createdAt}

stories.title: Role-based access (Admin / Teacher / Student)
stories.description: Limit access to admin pages and teacher-only features.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Teacher JWT, when accessing /api/admin/*, then return 403.
Given an Admin JWT, when accessing teacher endpoints, then allow.
Given an unauthenticated request to protected endpoints, then return 401.

stories.title: Create test with answer key (Teacher/Admin)
stories.description: Allow Teachers/Admins to create tests composed of questions and an answer key.
acceptance_criteria: Given teacher is authenticated, when POST /api/tests with test payload (title, metadata, questions) then create test and return 201 with test id.
Given invalid question data (missing text or type), then return 400 with validation errors.
When retrieving GET /api/tests/{id}, then response includes questions and answer key metadata (answer format must be excluded for student view unless authorized).
data_models: Question {id, testId, text, type, options[], correctAnswer, tags[]}

stories.title: Edit/Delete tests (Admin/Teacher)
stories.description: Allow editing of test content and deletion of tests.
acceptance_criteria: Given teacher owns the test, when PUT /api/tests/{id} with valid changes, then update and return 200.
Given admin request to DELETE /api/tests/{id}, when test exists, then delete and return 204.
Given malformed request, return 400.

stories.title: Upload photo of student's paper (OCR pipeline)
stories.description: Allow Students/Teachers to upload photos (jpg/png) of a filled test; run OCR and produce parsed answers.
acceptance_criteria: Given a photo uploaded to POST /api/ocr/upload, when image is valid, then return parsed text (raw OCR) and a structured candidate answer set.
Given unreadable image, return 422 with helpful message and an option to provide typed answers.
OCR pipeline must sanitize input and limit file size to 8MB for MVP.
data_models: OcrJob {id, userId, status, rawText, structuredAnswers, createdAt}

stories.title: Allow typed answers if OCR fails or user prefers typing
stories.description: Provide an editor on the TestView page where student answers can be typed/edited before grading.
acceptance_criteria: Given student on TestView, when editing answers and clicking Grade, then submission flows to grading endpoint.
Given user previously uploaded OCR, when editing that content, then edited answers are used.
data_models: StudentSubmission {id, testId, userId, answers[], createdAt, source: 'ocr'|'typed'}

stories.title: Grade student answers and generate per-question feedback
stories.description: Grade submissions against answer key, support partial credit for short/structured answers, and return actionable feedback explaining mistakes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a submission, when POST /api/tests/{id}/grade is called with answers, then respond within ~3s (dev) with: total_score, per_question results (question_id, correct, score, feedback, tags).
Feedback must include: correct answer explanation, error category tag (one of a defined set or free text), and 1–3 recommended resource ids.
Edge cases: handle missing answers (score 0) and malformed payloads (400).

stories.title: Provide teacher override and manual re-grade
stories.description: Allow a teacher to edit feedback and re-grade any submission.
acceptance_criteria: Given teacher role, when PUT /api/submissions/{id}/regrade with manual adjustments, then update stored result.
Changes must be audited (who changed, timestamp).

stories.title: Document ingestion and embedding for recommended readings
stories.description: Admin can ingest reading materials (title, body, url) to be embedded and stored in the vector DB (Qdrant).
acceptance_criteria: Given an admin uploads a resources.json or uses UI, when ingestion runs, then embeddings for each resource are computed and stored in vector DB with metadata.
Document ingestion endpoint returns ingestion status and number of items indexed.
Embedding service must use a free/open embedding model or a free-tier inference endpoint and document how to run it locally or via a free cloud provider.
data_models: Resource {id, title, url, body, tags[], createdAt}

stories.title: RecommendationService: query vector DB for top resources
stories.description: When grading finds mistake tags or constructs an embedding of the error, query Qdrant for best matches and return up to 3 resources.
acceptance_criteria: Given a per-question error (tag or short text), when recommendations requested, then return up to 3 resources with id, title, url, and snippet.
Results ranked by similarity; if no vector DB result, fallback to simple keyword match.

stories.title: Multiple layouts and routing
stories.description: Provide MainLayout (public & student) and AdminLayout (admin/teacher) with routing for pages: /, /tests, /tests/:id, /admin, /login.
acceptance_criteria: Given logged-in Admin, when visiting /admin, the AdminLayout shows sidebar and admin pages.
Given Student, when visiting /tests list, MainLayout header and nav show appropriate links.
Routing must be client-side (React Router v6) and pages should lazy-load.

stories.title: Test View: upload, OCR preview, grade and view results
stories.description: TestView should combine upload, OCR result editor, typed answers, and Grade button; display result inline.
acceptance_criteria: Given a test, when user uploads a photo and corrects OCR, clicking Grade triggers grade endpoint and displays results.
UI must show per-question feedback and resources as links.

stories.title: Basic score analytics (Teacher/Admin)
stories.description: Show score distribution and average per-test.
acceptance_criteria: Given a test with >=1 submissions, when teacher visits /tests/{id}/analytics, then show average score, score histogram (bins), and list of questions with percent correct.
API endpoint returns required metrics within acceptable time for <=500 submissions.

stories.title: Local dev setup + docker compose
stories.description: Provide docker-compose to run backend, frontend (dev), and Qdrant. Provide README with run steps.
acceptance_criteria: Given developer runs docker-compose up, when services start, then backend listens on :5000, frontend on :3000, qdrant on :6333.
Readme contains steps to run embedding service locally or use a free Hugging Face inference endpoint with an API key.

stories.title: CI workflow for build & tests
stories.description: Create GitHub Actions workflow to build backend, run unit tests, and run frontend build/tests.
acceptance_criteria: On push, CI runs dotnet restore/build/test and npm install/build/test and fails the pipeline on test failure.

sprint_1.focus: Project skeleton, auth, test creation, simple frontend skeleton, OCR MVP (file upload -> Tesseract), static recommendations fallback
deliverables: Create Test endpoint + simple DB models
Frontend skeleton (MainLayout, routing, Tests list and Test view stub)
OCR upload endpoint that returns raw OCR text (Tesseract integration)

sprint_2.focus: Grading service, embeddings ingestion, vector DB (Qdrant) local, RecommendationService MVP using embeddings
deliverables: Test grading endpoint (exact-match and simple partial credit)
Front-end TestView wired to grade endpoint and display recommendations
Basic unit tests for grading and recommendation

sprint_3.focus: Polish UX, Admin pages, analytics, CI, E2E tests
deliverables: Playwright E2E tests for grade flow

definition_of_done: App runs locally with docker-compose (backend, frontend dev server, qdrant)
User can create a test, upload photo (OCR) or type answers, grade, and see per-question feedback and up to 3 reading recommendations
Embeddings ingestion and vector DB query work end-to-end for recommendations
At least 5 backend unit tests and 2 frontend E2E tests pass
Auth with JWT and role-based access implemented for Admin/Teacher/Student
Codebase scaffolded and documented; README explains local dev, embedding model options, and how to replace LLM endpoints

data_model_summary.User: { id (uuid), name, email, passwordHash, role ('admin'|'teacher'|'student'), createdAt }
data_model_summary.Question: { id, testId, index, text, type ('mc'|'short'|'long'), options[], correctAnswer, tags[] }
data_model_summary.StudentSubmission: { id, testId, userId, source, answers[], createdAt }
data_model_summary.PerQuestionResult: { questionId, correct (bool), scoreGiven, feedbackText, errorTag, recommendedResourceIds[] }
data_model_summary.OcrJob: { id, userId, imageUrl, rawText, structuredAnswers, status }

notes_and_risks: OCR quality depends on image quality and layout of the paper; allow manual correction step before grading.
Embedding model selection important: recommend small open models for local use (e.g., sentence-transformers on TGI) or Hugging Face inference free tier for prototyping.
Privacy: student data should remain local or in your controlled environment; avoid sending images to third-party hosted APIs unless approved.
Performance: for production, vector DB and model hosting need compute (GPU recommended for large models); for MVP, small models and local TGI with CPU may be acceptable but slower.
question_for_architect: Confirm whether we should support multi-page tests with different scoring rules per question in the first release or keep single test-level uniform scoring for MVP.
